title: Droplets evaporating by the d² law
shows: 50 µm droplets injected for 50 ms into hot air shrink as d² = d₀² − K·t (K = 1e-8 m²/s, a 250 ms lifetime). 100 ms after the injection stops, 64.47 % of the liquid has evaporated: the mass of each parcel, (1 − K·t/d₀²)^(3/2), averaged over the injection.
source: The d² law of droplet evaporation: G. A. E. Godsave, Proc. Combust. Inst. 4 (1953) 818; S. R. Turns, An Introduction to Combustion, 3rd ed. (2012), ch. 3 and 10.

checks.what: evaporated share of the injected liquid
